```{r proc-data}
# Create ISCO 88 families-, 1 digit and grouped in 3 (Upper, intermediate, Lower) -------------------------------------
library(DIGCLASS)
dfreg$isco08res_3<- DIGCLASS::isco88_to_isco08(dfreg$isco88res_3,label = FALSE,to_factor = FALSE)
dfreg$isco08spo_3<- DIGCLASS::isco88_to_isco08(dfreg$isco88_3,label = FALSE,to_factor = FALSE)
dfreg %>% select(m03,isco88res_3,isco08res_3) %>% filter(!is.na(m03)& is.na(isco88res_3)) %>% head(20)
dfreg$isco08res_3 <- ifelse(dfreg$isco08res_3 %in% c(3452,1252,5164,9999,9955,9988),"2000",dfreg$isco08res_3)

dfreg$isco08_1lvlspo <- DIGCLASS::isco08_swap(dfreg$isco08spo_3,from = 4,to = 1)
dfreg$isco08_1lvl   <- DIGCLASS::isco08_swap(dfreg$isco08res_3,from = 4,to = 1)

dfreg$isco08_1lvlhh <- ifelse(is.na(dfreg$isco08_1lvl) & dfreg$m02 %in%c (4,5,6,7,8,9),yes = dfreg$isco08_1lvlspo,no = dfreg$isco08_1lvl)

frq(dfreg$isco08_1lvl)
frq(dfreg$isco08_1lvlhh)

dfreg %>% 
  group_by(isco08_1lvl) %>% 
  summarise(mean=mean(isei08res,na.rm=T),
            P10=quantile(isei08res,probs = 0.10,na.rm=T),
            P50=quantile(isei08res,probs = 0.50,na.rm=T),           
            P90=quantile(isei08res,probs = 0.90,na.rm=T))

#How many time is the mean individual income of the occupational group over the societal median (P50)?
dfreg %>% 
  filter(inc_ind>0) %>%
  filter(!isco08_1lvl=="0000") %>%
  group_by(isco08_1lvl) %>% 
  summarise(N=n(),mean=mean(inc_ind,na.rm=T),
            P10=quantile(inc_ind,probs = 0.10,na.rm=T),
            P50=quantile(inc_ind,probs = 0.50,na.rm=T),          
            P90=quantile(inc_ind,probs = 0.90,na.rm=T),
            shr_avg_P50=(mean/median(dfreg$inc_ind,na.rm=T)),
            shr_med_P50=(P50/median(dfreg$inc_ind,na.rm=T))) %>% 
  mutate(avg_P50_3T = ntile(shr_avg_P50,n = 5))

# retrieve information from firm size for the number of employees. However it needs some adjustments
# if the person works alone, and hire no employees the firm number should be 0
# if the person works alone, and hire no employees the number of employees should be 0

dfreg <- 
dfreg %>% 
  mutate(
    # if number of employees is NA, then retrieve the firm size as a proxy
    employee_number=ifelse((is.na(n_employees_r)),yes = firm_size,no =n_employees_r),
    # now, if the persons declares to work alone and hire no employees, force employee number to be 0 
    employee_number=ifelse(m07==5,yes = 0,no =n_employees_r)
  )

# this gives a curated number of employees only for people who hire 
summary(dfreg$employee_number==0)
table(dfreg$employee_number>10)

frq(dfreg$isco08_2lvl)

dfreg <- dfreg %>%
  mutate(
    # Ensure isco_minor is a two-digit character/numeric
    isco_minor = as.numeric(substr(isco08_2lvl, 1, 2)),

    # Determine supervisor status - requires a separate variable
    # supervisor = ifelse( ... ),

    # EGP Classification
    egp_class = case_when(
      # --- Class I: Higher Controllers / Professionals ---
      # Higher-level professionals (ISCO 21-26) and higher-level managers (ISCO 11-14) as employees/employers
      (isco_minor %in% c(11, 21:26) & ownership %in% c("employee")) ~ 1,
      (isco_minor %in% c(12:14) & ownership %in% c("employer") & employee_number>10) ~ 1, # employers with more than 10 persons in the company/firm      
      # --- Class II: Lower Controllers / Professionals ---
      # Lower-level managers and associate professionals
      (isco_minor %in% c(12:14, 31:35) & ownership =="employee") ~ 2,

      # --- Class IIIa: Routine Non-manual Clerical ---
      (isco_minor %in% c(41:44) & ownership == "employee") ~ 3,

      # --- Class IIIb: Routine Service and Sales ---
      (isco_minor %in% c(51:54) & ownership == "employee") ~ 4,

      # --- Class IVa: Small Self-Employed WITH Employees ---  selfemployed  OR employers with more than 10 persons in the company/firm
      ((ownership == "selfemployed" | ownership == "employer") & employee_number %in% c(1:10) & !(isco_minor %in% c(61:64))) ~ 5, # Non-agricultural

      # --- Class IVb: Small Self-Employed WITHOUT Employees ---
      (ownership == "selfemployed" & employee_number ==0  & !(isco_minor %in% c(61:64))) ~ 6, # Non-agricultural

      # --- Class IVc: Self-Employed Farmers (with or without employees) ---
      (ownership %in% c("selfemployed") & isco_minor %in% c(61:64)) ~ 11, # Often coded as 11

      # --- Class V: Manual Supervisors ---
      (isco_minor %in% c(70:83) & is_supervisor_r == 1) ~ 7,

      # --- Class VI: Skilled Manual Workers ---
      (isco_minor %in% c(71:73, 75, 80:83) & ownership == "employee" & is_supervisor_r == 0) ~ 8,

      # --- Class VIIa: Unskilled Manual Workers ---
      (isco_minor %in% c(91, 93, 94, 96) & ownership == "employee") ~ 9,

      # --- Class VIIb: Agricultural Labourers ---
      (isco_minor %in% c(92, 61) & ownership == "employee") ~ 10, # 61 might be skilled agri employees

      # Not in labor force
      ownership == "notinlabor" ~ 12,

      # Default
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

# Add value labels
dfreg$egp_class <- labelled::labelled(dfreg$egp_class,
                                       labels = c("I Higher Managerial/Professional/Employers" = 1,
                                                  "II Lower Managerial/Professional" = 2,
                                                  "IIIa Routine Clerical" = 3,
                                                  "IIIb Routine Service/Sales" = 4,
                                                  "IVa Small Self-Employed with Employees" = 5,
                                                  "IVb Small Self-Employed without Employees" = 6,
                                                  "V Manual Supervisors" = 7,
                                                  "VI Skilled Manual" = 8,
                                                  "VIIa Unskilled Manual" = 9,
                                                  "VIIb Agricultural Labour" = 10,
                                                  "IVc Self-Employed Farmers" = 11,
                                                  "Not in Labor" = 12))

dfreg$egp_class <- sjlabelled::to_factor(dfreg$egp_class)

# Income -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Deflator
# For 2021: CPI = 3.9  (baseline)
# For 2021: CPI = 12.8%
# For 2021: CPI = 7.2%
# For 2019: CPI = 3.0%
# For 2018: CPI = 2.6%
# For 2017: CPI = 2,3#
# For 2016: CPI = 2.7%

# The CPI values relative to 2021 are:
# 2019 CPI: 97.09
# 2018 CPI: 97.47
# 2017 CPI: 97.75
# 2016 CPI: 97.37

# 2023: 100.00
# 2022: 88.69
# 2021: 82.75
# 2019: 80.34
# 2018: 78.31
# 2017: 76.56
# 2016: 74.54

dfreg$cpi <- dfreg$ola
dfreg$cpi <- car::recode(dfreg$cpi,"1=74.54;2=76.56;3=78.31;4=78.31;5=82.75;6=88.69;7=100")
dfreg$real_income <- as.numeric((dfreg$ing_pc/dfreg$cpi)* 100)
dfreg$real_income_eq <- as.numeric((dfreg$ing_pc_eq/dfreg$cpi)* 100)
dfreg <- 
dfreg %>% 
  group_by(ola) %>% 
  mutate(weighted_mean_income=weighted.mean(x = real_income_eq,w = ponderador02,na.rm = T),
         income_distance = real_income_eq-weighted_mean_income) %>% as.data.frame()
dfreg$ing_pc_100 <- (dfreg$real_income_eq) # each unit is 100.000 CLP
dfreg$quintile <- dplyr::ntile(dfreg$real_income_eq,5) # income quintile deflated
dfreg$decile <- dplyr::ntile(dfreg$real_income_eq,10) # income decile deflated

# Network status and size ------------------------------------------------------

# Compute weighted mean, variance, and SD of ISEI for each respondent
dfreg <- dfreg %>%
  rowwise() %>%  # Operate row-by-row
  mutate(
    # Step 1: Total number of known people (sum of all n_* variables)
    total_n = sum(
      n_doctor, n_ceo, n_lawyer, n_univprof, n_account, n_secret,
      n_shopassi, n_kinder, n_waiter, n_carmech, n_taxi, n_stvend, n_cleaner,
      na.rm = TRUE  # Ignore NAs when summing
    ),

    # Step 2: Weighted mean of ISEI (sum(isei * n) / total_n)
    mean_isei = sum(
      isei_doctor   * n_doctor,
      isei_ceo      * n_ceo,
      isei_lawyer   * n_lawyer,
      isei_univprof * n_univprof,
      isei_account  * n_account,
      isei_secret   * n_secret,
      isei_shopassi * n_shopassi,
      isei_kinder   * n_kinder,
      isei_waiter   * n_waiter,
      isei_carmech  * n_carmech,
      isei_taxi     * n_taxi,
      isei_stvend   * n_stvend,
      isei_cleaner  * n_cleaner,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) / total_n,

    # Step 3: Weighted variance: sum(w * (x - mean)^2) / total_n
    var_isei = sum(
      n_doctor   * (isei_doctor   - mean_isei)^2,
      n_ceo      * (isei_ceo      - mean_isei)^2,
      n_lawyer   * (isei_lawyer   - mean_isei)^2,
      n_univprof * (isei_univprof - mean_isei)^2,
      n_account  * (isei_account  - mean_isei)^2,
      n_secret   * (isei_secret   - mean_isei)^2,
      n_shopassi * (isei_shopassi - mean_isei)^2,
      n_kinder   * (isei_kinder   - mean_isei)^2,
      n_waiter   * (isei_waiter   - mean_isei)^2,
      n_carmech  * (isei_carmech  - mean_isei)^2,
      n_taxi     * (isei_taxi     - mean_isei)^2,
      n_stvend   * (isei_stvend   - mean_isei)^2,
      n_cleaner  * (isei_cleaner  - mean_isei)^2,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) / total_n,

    # Step 4: Standard deviation = square root of variance
    sd_isei = sqrt(var_isei)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
dfreg$isei_cv <- (dfreg$sd_isei/dfreg$mean_isei)*100;summary(dfreg$isei_cv)

# Network entropy---------------------------------------------------------------
# Step 3: Compute Entropy separately
n_vars <- c("n_doctor", "n_ceo", "n_lawyer", "n_univprof", "n_account", 
            "n_secret", "n_shopassi", "n_kinder", "n_waiter", 
            "n_carmech", "n_taxi", "n_stvend", "n_cleaner")
dfreg <- 
  dfreg %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    entropy_contacts = {
      p_i <- c_across(all_of(n_vars))/total_n
      p_i <- p_i[p_i > 0]  # Avoid log(0)
      sum(p_i * log(p_i), na.rm = TRUE) * (-1)
    }
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
dfreg$entropy_contacts <- dfreg$entropy_contacts/log(13) # Normalize entropy (0-1)

# Network entropy + unemployed -------------------------------------------------
n_vars <- c("n_doctor", "n_ceo", "n_lawyer", "n_univprof", "n_account",
            "n_secret", "n_shopassi", "n_kinder", "n_waiter",
            "n_carmech", "n_taxi", "n_stvend", "n_cleaner","n_unemploy")

dfreg$n_unemploy <- as.numeric(car::recode(dfreg$r03_08,"1=0;2=1;3=3;4=6;5=9;6=13;7=17"))
dfreg <-
  dfreg %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    entropy_unemployed = {
      p_i <- c_across(all_of(n_vars))/(total_n+n_unemploy)
      p_i <- p_i[p_i > 0]  # Avoid log(0)
      sum(p_i * log(p_i), na.rm = TRUE) * (-1)
    }
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
dfreg$entropy_unemployed <- dfreg$entropy_unemployed/log(14) # Normalize entropy (0-1)

{df1$mobility <- car::recode(df1$isco03_neet,"c(4,NA)=0")
df1$mobility <- as.numeric(df1$mobility)+1
df1 <- 
df1 %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  mutate(
    n_obs   = n(),                                # total waves per person
    n_mob1  = sum(mobility == 1, na.rm = TRUE),   # how many of those waves have mobility==1
    n_mob2  = sum(mobility == 2, na.rm = TRUE),   # how many of those waves have mobility==2
    n_mob3  = sum(mobility == 3, na.rm = TRUE),   # how many of those waves have mobility==3
    n_mob4  = sum(mobility == 4, na.rm = TRUE),   # how many of those waves have mobility==4    
    prop_mob1 = n_mob1 / n_obs,                   # optional: the share of waves in mobility==1
    prop_mob2 = n_mob2 / n_obs,                   # optional: the share of waves in mobility==2
    prop_mob3 = n_mob3 / n_obs,                   # optional: the share of waves in mobility==3
    prop_mob4 = n_mob4 / n_obs,                   # optional: the share of waves in mobility==4    
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

mobility_proportion <- df1 %>% select(id,mobility,n_obs,n_mob1,prop_mob1,n_mob2,prop_mob2,n_mob3,prop_mob3,n_mob4,prop_mob4) %>% arrange(id)
# NEET =  not in employment, education or training
# Source: https://www.oecd.org/en/data/indicators/youth-not-in-employment-education-or-training-neet.html
{isei_mobility <- df1 %>%
  arrange(id, time) %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  summarise(
    isei_first = first(mobility[!is.na(mobility)]),
    isei_last  = last(mobility[!is.na(mobility)]),
    isei_mode  = mode(mobility[!is.na(mobility)]),
    n_obs=mean(n_obs),
    prop_mob1= mean(prop_mob1),
    prop_mob2= mean(prop_mob2),
    prop_mob3= mean(prop_mob3),
    prop_mob4= mean(prop_mob4),
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    mobility_cat = case_when(
      isei_first == 1 & isei_last == 1 ~ "Stable: NEET",
      isei_first == 2 & isei_last == 2 ~ "Stable: low",
      isei_first == 3 & isei_last == 3 ~ "Stable: middle",
      isei_first == 4 & isei_last == 4 ~ "Stable: high",
      isei_first == 2 & isei_last == 3 ~ "Upward (L to M)",
      isei_first == 3 & isei_last == 4 ~ "Upward (M to H)",
      isei_first == 2 & isei_last == 4 ~ "Upward (L to H)",
      isei_first == 1 & isei_last %in% c(4,3,2) ~ "Upward (NEET to Any)",            
      isei_first == 4 & isei_last == 3 ~ "Downward (H to M)",
      isei_first == 4 & isei_last == 2 ~ "Downward (H to L)",
      isei_first == 3 & isei_last == 2 ~ "Downward (M to L)",
      isei_first %in% c(4,3,2) & isei_last == 1 ~ "Downward (Any to NEET)",      
      TRUE                             ~ NA_character_
    ),
    moves=abs(isei_first-isei_last) # for those who are mobile, number of absolute rungs (0 to 3)
  ) %>%
  mutate(mobility_cat = factor(
    mobility_cat,
  )) %>% 
 arrange(-n_obs)
}
frq(isei_mobility$mobility_cat)
table(isei_mobility$mobility_cat,isei_mobility$n_obs)
mobility_categories<- c("Downward (Any to NEET)","Downward (H to L)","Downward (H to M)","Downward (M to L)",
  "Upward (L - H)","Upward (L - M)","Upward (M - H)","Upward (NEET to Any)")  
# Individuals with more than 75% of the time in NEET, have at least 3 observations and are wrongly classified as Downward or Upward mobility.
isei_mobility$toNEET <- ifelse(isei_mobility$prop_mob1 >=0.75 & isei_mobility$n_obs>=3 & isei_mobility$mobility_cat %in% mobility_categories,1,0)
# Individuals with more than 75% of the time in Low, have at least 3 observations and are wrongly classified as Downward or Upward mobility.
isei_mobility$toStLow <- ifelse(isei_mobility$prop_mob2 >=0.75 & isei_mobility$n_obs>=3 & isei_mobility$mobility_cat %in% mobility_categories,1,0)
# Individuals with more than 75% of the time in Middle, have at least 3 observations and are wrongly classified as Downward or Upward mobility.
isei_mobility$toStMid <- ifelse(isei_mobility$prop_mob3 >=0.75 & isei_mobility$n_obs>=3 & isei_mobility$mobility_cat %in% mobility_categories,1,0)
# Individuals with more than 75% of the time in High, have at least 3 observations and are wrongly classified as Downward or Upward mobility.
isei_mobility$toStHig <- ifelse(isei_mobility$prop_mob4 >=0.75 & isei_mobility$n_obs>=3 & isei_mobility$mobility_cat %in% mobility_categories,1,0)
isei_mobility$mobility_cat_adj <- isei_mobility$mobility_cat
isei_mobility$mobility_cat_adj[isei_mobility$toNEET==1] <- "Stable: NEET"
isei_mobility$mobility_cat_adj[isei_mobility$toStLow==1] <-"Stable: low"
isei_mobility$mobility_cat_adj[isei_mobility$toStMid==1] <-"Stable: middle" 
isei_mobility$mobility_cat_adj[isei_mobility$toStHig==1] <-"Stable: high" 

isei_mobility_isco <- isei_mobility
isei_mobility_isco <- isei_mobility_isco %>% rename(mobility_cat_adj_isco3=mobility_cat_adj,mobility_cat_unadj=mobility_cat)
frq(isei_mobility_isco$mobility_cat_adj_isco3)
}

      isei_first == 1 & isei_last %in% c(4,3,2) ~ "Upward (NEET to Any)",            
      isei_first == 4 & isei_last == 3 ~ "Downward (H to M)",
      isei_first == 4 & isei_last == 2 ~ "Downward (H to L)",
      isei_first == 3 & isei_last == 2 ~ "Downward (M to L)",
      isei_first %in% c(4,3,2) & isei_last == 1 ~ "Downward (Any to NEET)",      
      TRUE                             ~ NA_character_
    ),
  ) %>%
  mutate(mobility_cat = factor(
    mobility_cat,
  )) %>% 
 arrange(-n_obs)
}
frq(isei_mobility$mobility_cat)
table(isei_mobility$mobility_cat,isei_mobility$n_obs)

mobility_categories<- c("Downward (Any to NEET)","Downward (H to L)","Downward (H to M)","Downward (M to L)",
  "Upward (L - H)","Upward (L - M)","Upward (M - H)","Upward (NEET to Any)")  
# Individuals with more than 75% of the time in NEET, have at least 3 observations and are wrongly classified as Downward or Upward mobility.
isei_mobility$toNEET <- ifelse(isei_mobility$prop_mob1 >=0.75 & isei_mobility$n_obs>=3 & isei_mobility$mobility_cat %in% mobility_categories,1,0)
# Individuals with more than 75% of the time in Low, have at least 3 observations and are wrongly classified as Downward or Upward mobility.
isei_mobility$toStLow <- ifelse(isei_mobility$prop_mob2 >=0.75 & isei_mobility$n_obs>=3 & isei_mobility$mobility_cat %in% mobility_categories,1,0)
# Individuals with more than 75% of the time in Middle, have at least 3 observations and are wrongly classified as Downward or Upward mobility.

# Individuals with more than 75% of the time in High, have at least 3 observations and are wrongly classified as Downward or Upward mobility.
isei_mobility$toStHig <- ifelse(isei_mobility$prop_mob4 >=0.75 & isei_mobility$n_obs>=3 & isei_mobility$mobility_cat %in% mobility_categories,1,0)
isei_mobility$mobility_cat_adj <- isei_mobility$mobility_cat
isei_mobility$mobility_cat_adj[isei_mobility$toNEET==1] <- "Stable: NEET"
isei_mobility$mobility_cat_adj[isei_mobility$toStLow==1] <-"Stable: low"

isei_mobility$mobility_cat_adj[isei_mobility$toStHig==1] <-"Stable: high"
```

# 01 Paper

```{r prep-analysis-data}
pacman::p_load(dplyr, tidyr, purrr, sjmisc, lme4, plm, panelr, estimatr, ordinal, 
               marginaleffects, MLMusingR, correlation, 
               ggplot2, ggExtra, ggalluvial, ggtext, sjPlot, broom, 
               texreg, knitr, kableExtra)
load(file = here::here("input/data/proc/df1_panel_v2.RData"));paneldata137 <- paneldata
load(file = here::here("input/data/proc/df1_panel_for_mice.RData")); paneldata <- df1 

militares<- paneldata137 %>% filter(isco08_1lvl=="0000")
# Select variables for analysis
paneldata137 <- paneldata137 %>% 
  filter(!id %in% militares$id) %>%
  select(id,time,
         market,just_educ,just_salud,just_pension, # full information on Y
         n_total,isei_avg,entropy_contacts,know_total,crossclass,strong_tie, # full information on X
         sex,age,parenteducw1,migrationw1,isco_father,partner, # Controls
         isei_c,isco03_neet, # Rs occupation (O)
         mobility_cat_adj_isco3,mobility_cat_unadj,mobility_cat_adj_isco3b,mobility_cat_adj_isco3c,mobility_cat_adj_isco3d,mobility_cat_adj_egp3,moves, # Mobility (s)
         ponderador02,weights1,atricion) %>% 
  na.omit()
# Network diversity for longitudinal analysis
select(data.frame(paneldata137),"entropy_contacts","know_total","crossclass") %>% 
  correlation::correlation() %>% summary(digits=3) 

skimr::skim(select(data.frame(paneldata137),"entropy_contacts","know_total","crossclass") )

pca_fit_v10 <- 
  psych::pca(r = as.data.frame(paneldata137) %>% 
                     select("entropy_contacts","know_total","crossclass"),
                   nfactors = 1,rotate = "oblimin",scores = T,missing = T, 
                   cor = "cor",weight = paneldata137$ponderador02)
paneldata137$diversityclass <- as.numeric(pca_fit_v10$scores)

paneldata137$mobility_profile <-car::recode(
  paneldata137$mobility_cat_adj_isco3,
  "c('Downward (Any to NEET)',
    'Downward (H to L)',
    'Downward (H to M)',
    'Downward (M to L)') = 'Downward';
  c('Upward (L to H)',
    'Upward (L to M)',
    'Upward (M to H)',
    'Upward (NEET to Any)') = 'Upward'
  "
);paneldata137$mobility_profile <- relevel(paneldata137$mobility_profile,ref = "Stable: low")

paneldata137$isei_c <- car::Recode(paneldata137$isei_c,"0=10")
paneldata137$parenteducw1 <- factor(paneldata137$parenteducw1,ordered = F)
paneldata137$migrationw1 <- factor(paneldata137$migrationw1,ordered = F)

paneldata137$time<- car::recode(paneldata137$time,recodes = "3=2;7=3")
paneldata137 <- paneldata137 %>% group_by(id) %>% mutate(n_obs=n())

normalize <- function(x) {
  return ((x - min(x, na.rm = TRUE)) / (max(x, na.rm = TRUE) - min(x, na.rm = TRUE)))
}

paneldata137$know_total_norm<- normalize(paneldata137$know_total)
paneldata137$crossclass_norm<- normalize(paneldata137$crossclass)
paneldata137$diversitynml<- as.numeric((paneldata137$know_total_norm+paneldata137$entropy_contacts+paneldata137$crossclass_norm)/3)
summary(paneldata137$diversitynml)
```

## 1. DESCRIPTIVES

### Market justice and network diversity over time
```{r market-justice}
# paneldata137 is the dataframe
# ponderador02 is the cross-sectional weight
# market is the dependent variable
# time is the independent variable

set1 <-  RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n = 8, name = "Set1")
options(ggplot2.discrete.fill = set1)
options(ggplot2.discrete.colour = set1)
ggplot2::theme_set(ggplot2::theme_bw())
ggplot2::theme_update(text=ggplot2::element_text(size=15,  family="serif"))
# install.packages("estimatr")

library(estimatr)



trend_market <- lm(market ~ factor(time),data=paneldata137,weights = ponderador02)
predicted_factor_time<- predictions(trend_market,by = "time") %>% as.data.frame()

paneldata137$tiempo<- as.numeric(paneldata137$time)
trend_market_linear <- lm(market ~ tiempo,data=paneldata137,weights = ponderador02)
predicted_linear_time<- 
predictions(trend_market_linear,condition = c("tiempo"),
                 newdata = datagrid(tiempo=seq(1,3,by=0.1)))



plot_trend_market<- 
ggplot() + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = weighted.mean(paneldata137$market,na.rm=T,w=paneldata137$ponderador02) ,linetype=2,size=1,alpha=0.5,color='gray')+
  geom_ribbon(data=predicted_linear_time,aes(y = estimate,x = tiempo,ymin = conf.low,ymax = conf.high),alpha=0.3, color = "black",fill="white",linetype = 3, linewidth=0.5) + 
  geom_line(data=predicted_linear_time,aes(y = estimate,x = tiempo),size = 1, color = "black",alpha=0.2)  +
  geom_errorbar(data=predicted_factor_time,aes(y = estimate,x = factor(time),ymin = conf.low,ymax = conf.high),
                color = "black",width=0.02) + 
  geom_point(data = predicted_factor_time,aes(y = estimate,x = factor(time)),
             size = 1.5, color = "black") + 
  geom_line(data = predicted_factor_time,aes(y = estimate,x = factor(time),group=1),
             size = 0.5, color = "black",linetype=2) +
  scale_y_continuous(name=NULL,limits = c(1,3),n.breaks = 9,
                     # labels=c("Strongly\ndisagree","","","","Disagree","","","","Neither agree\nnor disagree"),
                     sec.axis =sec_axis(~ .,labels = c("(1) Strongly\ndisagree ","","",""," (2) Disagree","","","","(3) Neither agree\nnor disagree")))+
  scale_x_discrete(name=NULL,labels=c("Time 1\n(2016)","Time 2\n(2018)","Time 3\n(2023)"),expand = expansion(add = 0.1)) +
  # labs(caption = paste0("*Note*: The dashed line represents the sample mean for the three periods. The line corresponds to the linear trend with 95% CIs. Weighted estimates. *N* = ",format(dim(paneldata137)[1], big.mark = ","))) +
  labs(title = "A) Market justice preferences")+
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.caption = element_markdown(hjust = 1, size = 10),
    axis.text.y.right = element_text(size = 8)
  );plot_trend_market
```

```{r table-mobility}
dftabmobility <- 
frq(paneldata137$mobility_cat_adj_isco3,show.na = F) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(val2 = car::recode(val,
  "c('Downward (Any to NEET)',
    'Downward (H to L)',
    'Downward (H to M)',
    'Downward (M to L)') = 'Downward';
  c('Upward (L to H)',
    'Upward (L to M)',
    'Upward (M to H)',
    'Upward (NEET to Any)') = 'Upward'
  ")) %>% 
  select(val,val2,frq,raw.prc) %>% 
  left_join(
    frq(paneldata137$mobility_profile,show.na = F) %>% 
      as.data.frame() %>% 
      select(val2=val,frq2=frq,raw.prc2=raw.prc), by = "val2"
  ) %>% 
  select(val,frq,raw.prc,val2,frq2,raw.prc2) 
  
dftabmobility %>% 
  kable(col.names = c("Mobility","Freq.","%","Mobility","Freq.","%"),
        caption = "Table : Occupational socioeconomic status and intragenerational social mobility trajectories" ) %>% 
  kable_classic(html_font = "sans",full_width = F) %>% 
  collapse_rows(columns = 3:6)
```

## 2. MODELS: Regression fixed, random and multilevel

```{r table0001-0002}
# paneldata137$diversityclass<- scale(paneldata137$diversitynml)
paneldata137$mobility_profile <-car::recode(
  paneldata137$mobility_cat_adj_isco3,
  "c('Downward (Any to NEET)',
    'Downward (H to L)',
    'Downward (H to M)',
    'Downward (M to L)') = 'Downward';
  c('Upward (L to H)',
    'Upward (L to M)',
    'Upward (M to H)',
    'Upward (NEET to Any)') = 'Upward'
  "
);paneldata137$mobility_profile <- relevel(paneldata137$mobility_profile,ref = "Stable: low")

paneldata137$market1 <- as.numeric(scale(paneldata137$market))
paneldata137$diversityclass_gm<- ave(paneldata137$diversityclass, paneldata137$id, FUN = mean)
paneldata137$isei_gm<- ave(paneldata137$isei_c, paneldata137$id, FUN = mean)
paneldata137$partner_gm<- ave(paneldata137$partner, paneldata137$id, FUN = mean)
paneldata137$diversityclass_gc<- paneldata137$diversityclass - paneldata137$diversityclass_gm
paneldata137$time<- factor(paneldata137$time)

fe_1 <- # outcome scale in sd
  plm(market1~diversityclass+time+partner,data=paneldata137,weights = weights1,model = "within")

fe_2 <- # outcome orignal scale
  plm(market~diversityclass+time+partner,data=paneldata137,weights = weights1,model = "within")

re_1<- 
  plm(market1~diversityclass+mobility_profile+age+sex+time+parenteducw1+migrationw1+partner+partner_gm+diversityclass_gm, data=paneldata137,
      weights = weights1,model = "random",random.method = "walhus")

re_1b<- 
  plm(market1~diversityclass*mobility_profile+age+sex+time+parenteducw1+migrationw1+partner+partner_gm+diversityclass_gm, data=paneldata137,
      weights = weights1,model = "random",random.method = "walhus")


phtest(fe_1, re_1)

hlm_1 <- 
  lme4::lmer(market1 ~ diversityclass_gc+mobility_profile+diversityclass_gm+sex+age+parenteducw1+migrationw1+partner+partner_gm+time+(1|id),
             data = paneldata137,weights = weights1)
hlm_2 <- 
  lme4::lmer(market1 ~ diversityclass_gc*mobility_profile+diversityclass_gm+sex+age+parenteducw1+migrationw1+partner+partner_gm+time+(1|id),
             data = paneldata137,weights = weights1)

hlm_3 <- 
  lme4::lmer(market1 ~ diversityclass_gc+mobility_profile+diversityclass_gm+sex+age+parenteducw1+migrationw1+partner+partner_gm+time+(diversityclass_gc|id),
             data = paneldata137,weights = weights1)

hlm_4 <- 
  lme4::lmer(market1 ~ diversityclass_gc+mobility_profile+diversityclass_gm+sex+age+parenteducw1+migrationw1+partner+partner_gm+time+(diversityclass_gc|id),
             data = paneldata137,weights = NULL)

hlm_5 <- 
  lme4::lmer(market1 ~ diversityclass_gc*mobility_profile+diversityclass_gm+sex+age+parenteducw1+migrationw1+partner+partner_gm+time+(diversityclass_gc|id),
             data = paneldata137,weights = NULL)


screenreg(list(hlm_1,hlm_3,hlm_4,hlm_5))

anova(hlm_1,hlm_3)

var_labels <- list(
```

```{r figure002-AME}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(forcats)

plot_df <- 
  plot_slopes(hlm_2, variables = "diversityclass_gc", condition = c("mobility_profile"),draw = F) %>%
  select(mobility_profile,estimate,conf.high,conf.low,p.value) %>%
  mutate(
    # nice label: "−0.142 (p = 0.008)" with 3 decimals
    est_str = number(estimate, accuracy = 0.001, big.mark = "", decimal.mark = "."),
    p_str   = case_when(
      p.value < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
      TRUE            ~ number(p.value, accuracy = 0.001, big.mark = "", decimal.mark = ".")
    ),
    lab = paste0(est_str, " (p = ", p_str, ")"),
    mobility_profile = factor(mobility_profile,levels = c("Stable: NEET","Stable: low","Stable: middle","Downward","Upward","Stable: high"))
  )

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = mobility_profile, y = estimate,label=lab)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_pointrange(
    aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high),
    size = 0.6, fatten = 2, color = "black"
  ) +
  # place labels slightly to the right of the CI upper bound
  geom_text(
    nudge_y = -0.01,
    nudge_x = 0.2,
    hjust = 0, size = 3.4, family = "serif"
  ) +
  coord_flip(clip = "off") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "AME", 
       caption = paste0(
      "*Note*: N = ",
      nobs(hlm_2),
      ". 95% CIs. Based on hierarchical linear model (HLM)"
    )) +
  # theme_minimal(base_family = "serif") +
  theme(
    plot.caption = element_markdown(hjust = 1, size = 13),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r tableS07}
# Load required packages
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(dplyr)

# Create data frame with ISEI values and skill group (Main Scheme A)
# Excluding armed forces (0000)
isei_table <- data.frame(
  `ISCO Group` = c("1000", "2000", "3000", "4000", "5000", 
                   "6000", "7000", "8000", "9000"),
  `Occupational Group` = c("Managers", 
                           "Professionals", 
                           "Technicians and associate professionals", 
                           "Clerical support workers", 
                           "Service and sales workers", 
                           "Skilled agricultural workers", 
                           "Craft and related trades workers", 
                           "Plant and machine operators", 
                           "Elementary occupations"),
  `Mean ISEI` = c(53.7, 66.2, 50.8, 44.3, 35.8, 23.1, 32.2, 30.1, 18.5),
  `Skill Level` = c("High", "High", "High", 
                    "Intermediate", "Intermediate", "Intermediate", "Intermediate", "Intermediate", 
                    "Low"),
  check.names = FALSE
)

# Calculate skill group mean ISEI (average of Mean ISEI within each skill level)
skill_means <- isei_table %>%
  group_by(`Skill Level`) %>%
  summarise(`Skill Group Mean ISEI` = round(mean(`Mean ISEI`), 1)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Join skill group means to main table
final_table <- isei_table %>%
  left_join(skill_means, by = "Skill Level") %>%
  # Reorder columns exactly as requested
  select(`ISCO Group`, `Occupational Group`, `Mean ISEI`, 
         `Skill Level`, `Skill Group Mean ISEI`)

# Generate kable table with collapsed Skill Level column
kable(final_table, 
      caption = "Table: occupational socioeconomic status by ISCO-08 Group and Skill Level",
      digits = 1,
      format = "html",      # change to "latex" for PDF output
      booktabs = TRUE,
      col.names = c("ISCO Group", "Occupational Group", "ISEI", "Scheme", "ISEI")
) %>%
  kable_classic(html_font = "sans",full_width = F) %>% 
  # Collapse the Skill Level column for consecutive identical values
  collapse_rows(columns = 4:5, valign = "middle")  # column 5 = Skill Level
```

## Robust cross-lagged SEM

```{r lavaan-crosslag}
pacman::p_load(dplyr, tidyr, purrr, sjmisc, lme4, plm, panelr, estimatr, ordinal, 
               marginaleffects, MLMusingR, correlation, 
               ggplot2, ggExtra, ggalluvial, ggtext, sjPlot, broom,lavaan,
               texreg, knitr, kableExtra)
load(file = here::here("input/data/proc/df1_panel_v2.RData"));paneldata137 <- paneldata
load(file = here::here("input/data/proc/df1_panel_for_mice.RData")); paneldata <- df1 

paneldata137 <- paneldata137 %>% group_by(id) %>% mutate(n_obs=n())

# Network diversity for longitudinal analysis
pca_fit_v10 <- 
  psych::principal(r = as.data.frame(paneldata137) %>% 
                     select("entropy_contacts","know_total","crossclass"),
                   nfactors = 1,rotate = "varimax",scores = T,missing = T, 
                   cor = "cor",weight = paneldata137$weights1)
paneldata137$diversityclass <- as.numeric(pca_fit_v10$scores)

widepaneldata <- panelr::widen_panel(paneldata137,separator = "_w")

widepaneldata %>% select(diversityclass_w1,diversityclass_w3,diversityclass_w7) %>% correlation() %>% summary
widepaneldata %>% select(market_w1,market_w3,market_w7,diversityclass_w1,diversityclass_w3,diversityclass_w7)

library(lavaan)

data_w1w3 <- widepaneldata %>% select(know_total_w1,know_total_w3,entropy_contacts_w1,entropy_contacts_w3,
                                      just_educ_w1,just_educ_w3,
                                      just_salud_w1,just_salud_w3,
                                      just_pension_w1,just_pension_w3,
                                      weights1_w1,weights1_w3, ponderador02_w3
                                      ) %>% na.omit()

data_w1w3w7 <- widepaneldata %>% select(know_total_w1,know_total_w3,know_total_w7,
                                        entropy_contacts_w1,entropy_contacts_w3,entropy_contacts_w7,
                                      just_educ_w1,just_educ_w3,just_educ_w7,
                                      just_salud_w1,just_salud_w3,just_salud_w7,
                                      just_pension_w1,just_pension_w3,just_pension_w7,
                                      weights1_w7,ponderador02_w7
                                      ) %>% na.omit()

# market =~ just_educ + just_salud + just_pension # this is the latent variable for market justice, all indicators all ordered
# diversityclass =~ know_total + entropy_contacts # this is the latent variable for network diversity indicators are numeric

# _w1 =  wave 1
# _w2 =  wave 3
# _w7 =  wave 7

# ===== Model specification with method factor =====
m_clpm_w1w3_method <- '
  ##############################################
  # 1) Measurement: equal loadings across waves
  ##############################################
  market_w1 =~ l1*just_educ_w1 + l2*just_salud_w1 + l3*just_pension_w1
  market_w3 =~ l1*just_educ_w3 + l2*just_salud_w3 + l3*just_pension_w3

  diversity_w1 =~ k1*know_total_w1 + e1*entropy_contacts_w1
  diversity_w3 =~ k1*know_total_w3 + e1*entropy_contacts_w3

  market_w1   ~ 0*1
  diversity_w1~ 0*1

  ##############################################
  # 2) Structural: autoregression + cross-lags
  ##############################################
  market_w3    ~ b11*market_w1    + d_x2y*diversity_w1  
  diversity_w3 ~ a11*diversity_w1 + c_y2x*market_w1  

  ##############################################
  # 3) Same-wave latent covariances
  ##############################################
  market_w1 ~~ diversity_w1
  market_w3 ~~ diversity_w3

  ##############################################
  # 4) Temporal item residual covariances
  ##############################################
  just_educ_w1    ~~ just_educ_w3
  just_salud_w1   ~~ just_salud_w3
  just_pension_w1 ~~ just_pension_w3

  know_total_w1       ~~ know_total_w3
  entropy_contacts_w1 ~~ entropy_contacts_w3

  ##############################################
  # 5) Common-method factor (broad CMV)
  ##############################################
  method =~ 
      1*just_educ_w1 + 1*just_salud_w1 + 1*just_pension_w1 +
      1*just_educ_w3 + 1*just_salud_w3 + 1*just_pension_w3 +
      1*know_total_w1 + 1*entropy_contacts_w1 +
      1*know_total_w3 + 1*entropy_contacts_w3

  # Orthogonality to substantive factors
  method ~~ 0*market_w1 + 0*market_w3 + 0*diversity_w1 + 0*diversity_w3
'

ordered_items <- c(
  "just_educ_w1","just_educ_w3","just_educ_w7",
  "just_salud_w1","just_salud_w3","just_salud_w7",
  "just_pension_w1","just_pension_w3","just_pension_w7"
)

# ===== Estimation (WLSMV with ordered market items) =====
fit_method_w1w3 <- sem(
  m_clpm_w1w3_method,
  data              = data_w1w3w7,
  estimator         = "WLSMV",
  ordered           = ordered_items,sampling.weights = "weights1_w7"
)

summary(fit_method_w1w3, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)

# A) Three‑wave CLPM with method factor----------------------------------------
ordered_items <- c(
  "just_educ_w1","just_educ_w3","just_educ_w7",
  "just_salud_w1","just_salud_w3","just_salud_w7",
  "just_pension_w1","just_pension_w3","just_pension_w7"
)

m_clpm_w1w3w7_method <- '
  ################################################
  # 1) Measurement: equal loadings across waves
  ################################################
  # Market justice (ordered)
  market_w1 =~ l1*just_educ_w1   + l2*just_salud_w1   + l3*just_pension_w1
  market_w3 =~ l1*just_educ_w3   + l2*just_salud_w3   + l3*just_pension_w3
  market_w7 =~ l1*just_educ_w7   + l2*just_salud_w7   + l3*just_pension_w7

  # Network diversity (numeric)
  diversity_w1 =~ k1*know_total_w1       + e1*entropy_contacts_w1
  diversity_w3 =~ k1*know_total_w3       + e1*entropy_contacts_w3
  diversity_w7 =~ k1*know_total_w7       + e1*entropy_contacts_w7

  # Identification: fix baseline latent means
  market_w1    ~ 0*1
  diversity_w1 ~ 0*1

  ################################################
  # 2) Structural: autoregression + cross-lags
  #    (NON-STATIONARY: 1→3 vs 3→7 differ)
  ################################################
  # 1 → 3
  market_w3    ~ b13*market_w1    + d13*diversity_w1
  diversity_w3 ~ a13*diversity_w1 + c13*market_w1

  # 3 → 7
  market_w7    ~ b37*market_w3    + d37*diversity_w3
  diversity_w7 ~ a37*diversity_w3 + c37*market_w3

  ################################################
  # 3) Same-wave latent covariances
  ################################################
  market_w1 ~~ diversity_w1
  market_w3 ~~ diversity_w3
  market_w7 ~~ diversity_w7

  ################################################
  # 4) Temporal item residual covariances
  #    (same indicator across waves)
  ################################################
  # Market items (ordered)
  just_educ_w1    ~~ just_educ_w3
  just_educ_w3    ~~ just_educ_w7
  just_salud_w1   ~~ just_salud_w3
  just_salud_w3   ~~ just_salud_w7
  just_pension_w1 ~~ just_pension_w3
  just_pension_w3 ~~ just_pension_w7

  # Diversity items (numeric)
  know_total_w1       ~~ know_total_w3
  know_total_w3       ~~ know_total_w7
  entropy_contacts_w1 ~~ entropy_contacts_w3
  entropy_contacts_w3 ~~ entropy_contacts_w7

  ################################################
  # 5) Common-method factor (broad CMV)
  #    Unit loadings; orthogonal to trait factors
  ################################################
  method =~ 
      1*just_educ_w1    + 1*just_salud_w1    + 1*just_pension_w1 +
      1*just_educ_w3    + 1*just_salud_w3    + 1*just_pension_w3 +
      1*just_educ_w7    + 1*just_salud_w7    + 1*just_pension_w7 +
      1*know_total_w1   + 1*entropy_contacts_w1 +
      1*know_total_w3   + 1*entropy_contacts_w3 +
      1*know_total_w7   + 1*entropy_contacts_w7

  method ~~ 0*market_w1 + 0*market_w3 + 0*market_w7 +
            0*diversity_w1 + 0*diversity_w3 + 0*diversity_w7
'
fit_method_w1w3w7 <- sem(
  m_clpm_w1w3w7_method,
  data              = data_w1w3w7,
  estimator         = "WLSMV",
  ordered           = ordered_items,sampling.weights = "weights1_w7"
  # WLSMV handles missing via pairwise-present;
  # if you prefer FIML, treat Likert as continuous (see note below)
)

summary(fit_method_w1w3w7, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)

# Custom labels for screenreg() -> custom.coef.map =
clpm_coef_labels <- list(
  # --- W1 -> W3 ---
  "market_w3 ~ market_w1"      = "Stability: Market (W1 → W3)",
  "market_w7 ~ market_w3"      = "Stability: Market (W3 → W7)",
  "diversity_w3 ~ diversity_w1"= "Stability: Diversity (W1 → W3)",
  "diversity_w7 ~ diversity_w3"= "Stability: Diversity (W3 → W7)",
  "diversity_w3 ~ market_w1"   = "Cross-lag: Market (W1) → Diversity (W3)",
  "market_w3 ~ diversity_w1"   = "Cross-lag: Diversity (W1) → Market (W3)",
  "diversity_w7 ~ market_w3"   = "Cross-lag: Market (W3) → Diversity (W7)",
  "market_w7 ~ diversity_w3"   = "Cross-lag: Diversity (W3) → Market (W7)"
)

screenreg(list(fit_method_w1w3,fit_method_w1w3w7),digits = 3,single.row = F,
          custom.coef.map = clpm_coef_labels
)
```

## Robust lagged first differences

```{r plm-crosslag}
pacman::p_load(dplyr, tidyr, purrr, sjmisc, lme4, plm, panelr, estimatr, ordinal,

load(file = here::here("input/data/proc/df1_panel_for_mice.RData")); paneldata <- df1 

militares<- paneldata137 %>% filter(isco08_1lvl=="0000")
# Select variables for analysis
paneldata137 <- paneldata137 %>% 
  filter(!id %in% militares$id) %>%
  select(id,time,
         market,just_educ,just_salud,just_pension, # full information on Y
         n_total,isei_avg,entropy_contacts,know_total,crossclass,strong_tie, # full information on X
         sex,age,parenteducw1,migrationw1,isco_father,partner, # Controls
         soclass,soclass3a,soclass3b, isei_c,isco03_neet, # Rs occupation (O)
         mobility_cat_adj_isco3,mobility_cat_adj_isco3b,mobility_cat_adj_isco3c, # Mobility (s)
         ponderador02,weights1,atricion) %>% 
  na.omit()
# Network diversity for longitudinal analysis
pca_fit_v10 <- 
  psych::principal(r = as.data.frame(paneldata137) %>% 
                     select("entropy_contacts","know_total","crossclass"),
                   nfactors = 1,rotate = "varimax",scores = T,missing = T, 
                   cor = "cor",weight = paneldata137$weights1)
paneldata137$diversityclass <- as.numeric(pca_fit_v10$scores)

paneldata137$mobility_profile <-car::recode(
  paneldata137$mobility_cat_adj_isco3,
  "c('Downward (Any to NEET)',
    'Downward (H to L)',
    'Downward (H to M)',
    'Downward (M to L)') = 'Downward';
  c('Upward (L to H)',
    'Upward (L to M)',
    'Upward (M to H)',
    'Upward (NEET to Any)') = 'Upward'
  "
)

paneldata137$parenteducw1 <- factor(paneldata137$parenteducw1,ordered = F)
paneldata137$migrationw1 <- factor(paneldata137$migrationw1,ordered = F)
paneldata137$mobility_profile <- relevel(paneldata137$mobility_profile,ref = "Stable: low")

paneldata137$time<- car::recode(paneldata137$time,recodes = "3=2;7=3",as.factor = T)

df_fixed<- paneldata137 %>%filter(time==1) %>%  select(id,agew1=age,-time)

paneldata137 <- left_join(paneldata137,df_fixed,by='id')
paneldata137$time<- as.numeric(as.factor(paneldata137$time))

paneldata137 <- paneldata137 %>% group_by(id) %>% mutate(n_obs=n())
paneldata137_balanced <- paneldata137 %>% filter(n_obs==3)

haven::write_dta(data = as.data.frame(paneldata137_balanced),path = here::here("input/data/proc/df1_panelV2.dta"))

# * IMPORTANTE: USAR CLUSTER SE AT THE LEVEL OF RESPONDENTS FOR ALL MODELS
# * First set: Table 1, models 1 and 4

cl_1 <- plm(diversityclass ~ lag(diversityclass) +
lag(market) + factor(time)+ sex + agew1 ,  data=paneldata137_balanced,
index = c("id", "time"), model = "pooling")

cl_2 <- plm(market ~ lag(market) +
lag(diversityclass)+ factor(time)+ sex + agew1 ,  data=paneldata137_balanced,
index = c("id", "time"), model = "pooling")

# Lagged first-difference Y~X and X~Y 

cl_3 <- plm(diversityclass ~ lag(market) + factor(time) + lag(partner),
data=paneldata137_balanced,
index = c("id", "time"), model = "fd")

cl_4 <- plm(market ~ lag(diversityclass) + factor(time)+ lag(partner),
data=paneldata137_balanced,
index = c("id", "time"), model = "fd")

cl_5 <- plm(diversityclass ~ lag(market) + market + factor(time)+ lag(partner),
data=paneldata137_balanced,
index = c("id", "time"), model = "fd")

cl_6 <- plm(market ~ lag(diversityclass) + diversityclass + factor(time)+ lag(partner) + partner,
data=paneldata137_balanced,
index = c("id", "time"), model = "fd")

cl_7 <- plm(market ~ diversityclass + factor(time)+ lag(partner) + lag(age) + partner +age,
data=paneldata137_balanced,
index = c("id", "time"), model = "within",effect = "individual")
noweights<- list(cl_3,cl_4,cl_5,cl_6)

robse_cl_1 <- sqrt(diag(vcovHC(cl_1, type="HC0",cluster="group")))
robse_cl_2 <- sqrt(diag(vcovHC(cl_2, type="HC0",cluster="group")))
robse_cl_3 <- sqrt(diag(vcovHC(cl_3, type="HC0",cluster="group")))
robse_cl_4 <- sqrt(diag(vcovHC(cl_4, type="HC0",cluster="group")))
robse_cl_5 <- sqrt(diag(vcovHC(cl_5, type="HC0",cluster="group")))
robse_cl_6 <- sqrt(diag(vcovHC(cl_6, type="HC0",cluster="group")))

pval_cl_1 <- (1 - pnorm(abs(coef(cl_1))/robse_cl_1))*2
pval_cl_2 <- (1 - pnorm(abs(coef(cl_2))/robse_cl_2))*2
pval_cl_3 <- (1 - pnorm(abs(coef(cl_3))/robse_cl_3))*2
pval_cl_4 <- (1 - pnorm(abs(coef(cl_4))/robse_cl_4))*2
 <- (1 - pnorm(abs(coef(cl_5))/robse_cl_5))*2
pval_cl_6 <- (1 - pnorm(abs(coef(cl_6))/robse_cl_6))*2

stargazer::stargazer(list(cl_3,cl_4,cl_5,cl_6),digits = 3,type = "text") 

screenreg(noweights,digits = 3)

var_labels_lags <- list(
  "lag(market)" = "Δ Market justice ₜ₋₁"
  "lag(diversityclass)" = "Δ Network diversity ₜ₋₁",
  "market" = "Δ Market justice",
  "diversityclass" = "Δ Network diversity"  
  )

htmlreg(noweights,digits = 4,
          custom.header = list("Outcome"=1:4),
          custom.model.names = c("Network<br>Diversity","Market<br>justice","Network<br>Diversity","Market<br>justice"),
          override.se = list(robse_cl_3,robse_cl_4, robse_cl_5, robse_cl_6),
          override.pvalues = list(pval_cl_3,pval_cl_4, pval_cl_5,pval_cl_6),
          custom.coef.map = var_labels_lags,
  caption.above = T,
  caption = "Table : Lagged first difference linear panel regression for market justice preferences and network diversity",
  stars = c(0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1),
  include.ci = FALSE,

  ),

          )

data=paneldata137_balanced,
```

```{r tableS05}
         scaleup1,scaleup2,scaleup3,
         sex,age,parenteducw1,migrationw1,isco_father,partner, # Controls
         soclass,soclass3a,soclass3b, isei_c,isco03_neet, # Rs occupation (O)
         mobility_cat_adj_isco3,mobility_cat_adj_isco3b,mobility_cat_adj_isco3c, # Mobility (s)
         ponderador02,weights1,atricion) %>% na.omit()
df_studies_plaza_otero$market1 <- scale(df_studies_plaza_otero$market)

pca_fit_v10 <-
  psych::principal(r = as.data.frame(df_studies_plaza_otero) %>%
                     select(iqvclass,crossclass,know_total,sd_isei,isei_range),
                   nfactors = 1,rotate = "varimax",scores = T,missing = T,
                   cor = "cor",weight = df_studies_plaza_otero$weights1)
df_studies_plaza_otero$div_otero <- as.numeric(pca_fit_v10$scores)

pca_fit_v10 <-
  psych::principal(r = as.data.frame(df_studies_plaza_otero) %>%
                     select(iqvclass,crossclass,know_total,sd_isei),
                   nfactors = 1,rotate = "varimax",scores = T,missing = T,
                   cor = "cor",weight = df_studies_plaza_otero$weights1)

df_studies_plaza_otero$div_plaza <- as.numeric(pca_fit_v10$scores)

my_estimations<- 
list(
my_study <- plm(market1 ~ diversityclass+time+partner,data=df_study2,weights = weights1, model="within",effect = "individual")
)
otero_estimations<- 
list(
otero_study <- plm(market1 ~ div_otero+time+partner,data=df_studies_plaza_otero,weights = weights1, model="within",effect = "individual")
)

plaza_estimations<- 
list(
plaza_study <- plm(market1 ~ div_plaza+time+partner,data=df_studies_plaza_otero,weights = weights1, model="within",effect = "individual")
)

var_labels_diversity <- list(
  diversityclass = "Network diversity",

  scaleup3 = "Size (Plaza et al.)",   
  time2="2018 (Ref.=2016)",
  time3="2023",  
  "(Intercept)"="Constant"
)

htmlreg(c(my_estimations,otero_estimations,plaza_estimations),digits = 3,caption.above = T,
          custom.coef.map = var_labels_diversity,
  caption = "Table : Fixed effects regression for market justice preferences and network diversity. Comparison with previous studies.",
  custom.gof.rows =  list(

  ),
```

## Robustness with random slopes

```{r random-slopes}
# paneldata137$diversityclass<- scale(paneldata137$diversitynml)
paneldata137$mobility_profile <-car::recode(
  paneldata137$mobility_cat_adj_isco3,
  "c('Downward (Any to NEET)',
    'Downward (H to L)',
    'Downward (H to M)',
    'Downward (M to L)') = 'Downward';
  c('Upward (L to H)',
    'Upward (L to M)',
    'Upward (M to H)',
    'Upward (NEET to Any)') = 'Upward'
  "
);paneldata137$mobility_profile <- relevel(paneldata137$mobility_profile,ref = "Stable: low")

paneldata137$mobility_cat_adj_isco3 <- relevel(paneldata137$mobility_cat_adj_isco3,ref = "Stable: low")

paneldata137$market1 <- as.numeric(scale(paneldata137$market))
paneldata137$diversityclass_gm<- ave(paneldata137$diversityclass, paneldata137$id, FUN = mean)
paneldata137$isei_gm<- ave(paneldata137$isei_c, paneldata137$id, FUN = mean)
paneldata137$partner_gm<- ave(paneldata137$partner, paneldata137$id, FUN = mean)
paneldata137$diversityclass_gc<- paneldata137$diversityclass - paneldata137$diversityclass_gm
paneldata137$time<- factor(paneldata137$time)



# Random random intercept  with interaction (with weights)

hlm_ri0 <- 
  lme4::lmer(market1 ~ diversityclass_gc*mobility_profile+diversityclass_gm+sex+age+parenteducw1+migrationw1+partner+partner_gm+time+(1|id),
             data = paneldata137,weights = weights1)

# Random random intercept  with interaction (no weights)

hlm_ri00 <- 
  lme4::lmer(market1 ~ diversityclass_gc*mobility_profile+diversityclass_gm+sex+age+parenteducw1+migrationw1+partner+partner_gm+time+(1|id),
             data = paneldata137,weights = NULL)

# Random random intercept model (with weights)

hlm_ri1 <- 
  lme4::lmer(market1 ~ diversityclass_gc+mobility_profile+diversityclass_gm+sex+age+parenteducw1+migrationw1+partner+partner_gm+time+(1|id),
             data = paneldata137,weights = weights1)

# Random random intercept model (no weights)

hlm_ri2 <- 
  lme4::lmer(market1 ~ diversityclass_gc+mobility_profile+diversityclass_gm+sex+age+parenteducw1+migrationw1+partner+partner_gm+time+(1|id),
             data = paneldata137,weights = NULL)

# Random slope model (with weights)
hlm_rs1 <- 
  lme4::lmer(market1 ~ diversityclass_gc+mobility_profile+diversityclass_gm+sex+age+parenteducw1+migrationw1+partner+partner_gm+time+(diversityclass_gc|id),
             data = paneldata137,weights = weights1)

# Random slope model (no weights)

hlm_rs2 <- 
  lme4::lmer(market1 ~ diversityclass_gc+mobility_profile+diversityclass_gm+sex+age+parenteducw1+migrationw1+partner+partner_gm+time+(diversityclass_gc|id),
             data = paneldata137,weights = NULL)

# Random slope model and interaction (with weights)

hlm_ci1 <- 
  lme4::lmer(market1 ~ diversityclass_gc*mobility_profile+diversityclass_gm+sex+age+parenteducw1+migrationw1+partner+partner_gm+time+(diversityclass_gc|id),
             data = paneldata137,weights = weights1)

# Random slope model and interaction (no weights)

hlm_ci2 <- 
  lme4::lmer(market1 ~ diversityclass_gc*mobility_profile+diversityclass_gm+sex+age+parenteducw1+migrationw1+partner+partner_gm+time+(diversityclass_gc|id),
             data = paneldata137,weights = NULL)


# Fixed effects model with interaction (with weights)

fe_ci1 <- 
  plm(market1~diversityclass*mobility_profile+time+partner,data=paneldata137,weights = weights1,model = "within")

# Fixed effects model with interaction (no weights)

fe_ci2 <- 
  plm(market1~diversityclass*mobility_profile+time+partner,data=paneldata137,weights = NULL,model = "within")


screenreg(list(hlm_ri1,hlm_ri2,hlm_rs1,hlm_rs2,hlm_ri0,hlm_ri00,hlm_ci1,hlm_ci2,fe_ci1,fe_ci2))

mods_ml <- list(hlm_ri1, hlm_ri2, hlm_rs1, hlm_rs2, hlm_ri0, hlm_ri00, hlm_ci1, hlm_ci2)
mods_fe <- list(fe_ci1, fe_ci2)
mods    <- c(mods_ml, mods_fe)


# 3. Column labels with model type
model_names <- paste0("Model ", 1:10, "<br>",
  c("RI, weighted", "RI, unweighted", "RS, weighted", "RS, unweighted",
    "RI, weighted", "RI, unweighted", "RS, weighted", "RS, unweighted",
    "FE, weighted", "FE, unweighted"))

# 4. Specification rows
spec_rows <- list(
  "Model specification" = c("RI", "RI", "RS", "RS",
                  "RI", "RI", "RS", "RS",
                  "FE", "FE"),
  "Weights" = c("Yes","No","Yes","No","Yes","No","Yes","No","Yes","No"),
  # "Diversity × trajectory" = c(rep("No", 4), rep("Yes", 6)),
  "Controls" = c(rep("Yes", 8), "Yes", "Yes")
)

# 5. Coefficient labels (edit if your names differ)
var_labels <- list(
  "diversityclass_gc" = "Network diversity",
  "diversityclass"    = "Network diversity",
  "mobility_profileStable: NEET"   = "Stable: NEET (ref.=St.Low)",

# 6. Table
htmlreg(mods,
  digits = 3, single.row = FALSE, caption.above = TRUE,
  caption = "Table S11. Market justice preferences and network diversity, multilevel and fixed-effects models",
  stars = c(0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1),
```

## Regression mobility profile, diversity and marke justice (head household)
```{r tableX03}
paneldata137$mobility_profile_hh <-car::recode(
  paneldata137$mobility_cat_adj_hh,
  "c('Downward (Any to NEET)',
    'Downward (H to L)',
    'Downward (H to M)',
    'Downward (M to L)') = 'Downward';
  c('Upward (L to H)',
    'Upward (L to M)',
    'Upward (M to H)',
    'Upward (NEET to Any)') = 'Upward'
  "
)

paneldata137$mobility_profile_hh <- relevel(paneldata137$mobility_profile_hh,ref = "Stable: low")
paneldata137$mobility_profile2 <-car::recode(
  paneldata137$mobility_cat_adj,
  "c('Downward (Any to NEET)',
    'Downward (H to L)',
    'Downward (H to M)',
    'Downward (M to L)') = 'Downward';
  c('Upward (L to H)',
    'Upward (L to M)',
    'Upward (M to H)',
    'Upward (NEET to Any)') = 'Upward';
    else = 'Stable'
  ")
paneldata137$mobility_profile2 <- relevel(paneldata137$mobility_profile2,ref = "Stable")

paneldata137$mobility_profile2_hh <-car::recode(
  paneldata137$mobility_cat_adj_hh,
  "c('Downward (Any to NEET)',
    'Downward (H to L)',
    'Downward (H to M)',
    'Downward (M to L)') = 'Downward';
  c('Upward (L to H)',
    'Upward (L to M)',
    'Upward (M to H)',
    'Upward (NEET to Any)') = 'Upward';
    else = 'Stable'
  ")
paneldata137$mobility_profile2_hh <- relevel(paneldata137$mobility_profile2_hh,ref = "Stable")
mkt_just_upward <- plm(market ~ diversityclass+age+I(age^2)+n_total+isei_avg,data=paneldata137,weights = weights1, model="within",effect = "twoways", subset = mobility_profile_hh=="Upward")
mkt_just_downward <- plm(market ~ diversityclass+age+I(age^2)+n_total+isei_avg,data=paneldata137,weights = weights1, model="within",effect = "twoways", subset = mobility_profile_hh=="Downward")
mkt_just_stnet <- plm(market ~ diversityclass+age+I(age^2)+n_total+isei_avg,data=paneldata137,weights = weights1, model="within",effect = "twoways", subset = mobility_profile_hh=="Stable: NEET")
mkt_just_stlow <- plm(market ~ diversityclass+age+I(age^2)+n_total+isei_avg,data=paneldata137,weights = weights1, model="within",effect = "twoways", subset = mobility_profile_hh=="Stable: low")
mkt_just_stmid <- plm(market ~ diversityclass+age+I(age^2)+n_total+isei_avg,data=paneldata137,weights = weights1, model="within",effect = "twoways", subset = mobility_profile_hh=="Stable: middle")
mkt_just_sthig <- plm(market ~ diversityclass+age+I(age^2)+n_total+isei_avg,data=paneldata137,weights = weights1, model="within",effect = "twoways", subset = mobility_profile_hh=="Stable: high")
mkt_just_stable <- plm(market ~ diversityclass+age+I(age^2)+n_total+isei_avg,data=paneldata137,weights = weights1, model="within",effect = "twoways", subset = mobility_profile2_hh=="Stable")
mkt_just_mobi <- plm(market ~ diversityclass*mobility_profile_hh+age+I(age^2)+n_total+isei_avg,data=paneldata137,weights = weights1, model="within",effect = "twoways")
mkt_just_mobi2 <- plm(market ~ diversityclass*mobility_profile2_hh+age+I(age^2)+n_total+isei_avg,data=paneldata137,weights = weights1, model="within",effect = "twoways")

Mobility_models<- list(Upward=mkt_just_upward,
                       Downward=mkt_just_downward,
                       "St. Low"=mkt_just_stlow,
                       "St. Middle"=mkt_just_stmid,
                       "St. High"=mkt_just_sthig,
                       "St. NEET"=mkt_just_stnet,
                       "Stable"=mkt_just_stable,
                       "Int."=mkt_just_mobi,
                       "Int."=mkt_just_mobi2)

custom.coef.map = list("diversityclass" = "Network diversity",
                       "isei_avg"="Network status","n_total"="Network size",                       
                       "I(diversityclass^2)" = "Network diversity²",
                       "age" = "Age",
                       "I(age^2)" = "Age²",
  "diversityclass:mobility_profile_hhDownward" = "Diversity × Downward",
  "diversityclass:mobility_profile_hhUpward" = "Diversity × Upward",
  "diversityclass:mobility_profile2_hhDownward" = "Diversity × Downward",
  "diversityclass:mobility_profile2_hhUpward" = "Diversity × Upward",
  "diversityclass:mobility_profile_hhStable: NEET" = "Diversity × Stable: NEET",
  "diversityclass:mobility_profile_hhStable: high" = "Diversity × Stable: high",
  "diversityclass:mobility_profile_hhStable: middle" = "Diversity × Stable: middle"
)

htmlreg(
  Mobility_models,single.row = F,
  caption.above = T,digits = 3,
  caption = "Table X3: Fixed effects regression for market justice preferences and network diversity by mobility profiles (head household)",
  stars = c(0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1),
  custom.coef.map = custom.coef.map,
  include.ci = FALSE,
  omit.coef = "(Intercept)|(time)",
  custom.gof.rows =  list(
    "Unit FE" = c("Yes", "Yes","Yes","Yes","Yes","Yes","Yes","Yes","Yes"),
    "Time FE" = c("Yes", "Yes","Yes","Yes","Yes","Yes","Yes","Yes","Yes")
  ),
  include.rsquared = F,
  include.adjrs = F,
  file = here::here("output/tables/tableX03.html"),
  custom.note = "%stars; Standard errors in parentheses."
)

diversity_values <- seq(min(paneldata137$diversityclass),
                        max(paneldata137$diversityclass), by = 0.1)
int_diversity <- mkt_just_mobi
df_pred1 <- marginaleffects::predictions(mkt_just_sthig, condition = c("diversityclass"), newdata = datagrid(diversityclass = diversity_values))

df_pred1 %>% ggplot(aes(
  y = estimate,
  x = diversityclass,
  ymin = conf.low,
  ymax = conf.high
)) + geom_ribbon(alpha = 0.1, color = "black") + geom_line(size = 1, color = "black") + geom_point(size = 2, color = "black") + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(1.5, 3)) + scale_x_continuous(limits = c(
  min(paneldata137$diversityclass),
  max(paneldata137$diversityclass)
)) + labs(
  caption = paste0("*Note*: N = ", nobs(int_diversity), ". 95% CIs. Model 3."),
  x = "Network diversity (z-score)",
  y = "Market justice preferences"
) + theme(plot.caption = element_markdown(hjust = 1, size = 13),
          legend.position = "none")
```

```{r table0X04}
mkt_just1 <- plm(market ~ diversityclass+n_total+isei_avg+isei_c+age+I(age^2)+neet,data=paneldata137,weights = weights1, model="within",effect = "twoways")
mkt_just2 <- plm(market ~ diversityclass+I(diversityclass^2)+isei_c+age+I(age^2)+n_total+isei_avg +neet,data=paneldata137,weights = weights1, model="within",effect = "twoways")

mkt_just3 <- plm(market ~ diversityclass+n_total+isei_avg+isei_d+age+I(age^2)+neet,data=paneldata137,weights = weights1, model="within",effect = "twoways")
mkt_just4 <- plm(market ~ diversityclass+I(diversityclass^2)+isei_d+age+I(age^2)+n_total+isei_avg +neet,data=paneldata137,weights = weights1, model="within",effect = "twoways")

mkt_just6 <- plm(market ~ diversityclass+I(diversityclass^2)+isei_d+age+I(age^2)+n_total+isei_avg +neet,data=paneldata137,weights = weights1, model="within",effect = "twoways",subset = neet==0)
```

```{}
# Mobility profiles (SES Class income-education) -----------------------------------------------




frq(df1$sesclass)
df1$sesclassn<- as.numeric(df1$sesclass)

df1$mobility <- as.numeric(df1$sesclassn)+1
df1 <-
df1 %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  mutate(
    n_obs   = n(),                                # total waves per person
    n_mob1  = sum(mobility == 1, na.rm = TRUE),   # how many of those waves have mobility==1
    n_mob2  = sum(mobility == 2, na.rm = TRUE),   # how many of those waves have mobility==2
    n_mob3  = sum(mobility == 3, na.rm = TRUE),   # how many of those waves have mobility==3
    n_mob4  = sum(mobility == 4, na.rm = TRUE),   # how many of those waves have mobility==4
    prop_mob1 = n_mob1 / n_obs,                   # optional: the share of waves in mobility==1
    prop_mob2 = n_mob2 / n_obs,                   # optional: the share of waves in mobility==2
    prop_mob3 = n_mob3 / n_obs,                   # optional: the share of waves in mobility==3
    prop_mob4 = n_mob4 / n_obs,                   # optional: the share of waves in mobility==4
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

mobility_proportion <- df1 %>% select(id,mobility,n_obs,n_mob1,prop_mob1,n_mob2,prop_mob2,n_mob3,prop_mob3,n_mob4,prop_mob4) %>% arrange(id)
# NEET =  not in employment, education or training
# Source: https://www.oecd.org/en/data/indicators/youth-not-in-employment-education-or-training-neet.html
{isei_mobility <- df1 %>%
  arrange(id, time) %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  summarise(
    isei_first = first(mobility[!is.na(mobility)]),
    isei_last  = last(mobility[!is.na(mobility)]),
    isei_mode  = mode(mobility[!is.na(mobility)]),
    n_obs=mean(n_obs),
    prop_mob1= mean(prop_mob1),
    prop_mob2= mean(prop_mob2),
    prop_mob3= mean(prop_mob3),
    prop_mob4= mean(prop_mob4),
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    mobility_cat = case_when(
      isei_first == 1 & isei_last == 1 ~ "Stable: NEET",
      isei_first == 2 & isei_last == 2 ~ "Stable: low",
      isei_first == 3 & isei_last == 3 ~ "Stable: middle",
      isei_first == 4 & isei_last == 4 ~ "Stable: high",
      isei_first == 2 & isei_last == 3 ~ "Upward (L to M)",
      isei_first == 3 & isei_last == 4 ~ "Upward (M to H)",
      isei_first == 2 & isei_last == 4 ~ "Upward (L to H)",
      isei_first == 1 & isei_last %in% c(4,3,2) ~ "Upward (NEET to Any)",
      isei_first == 4 & isei_last == 3 ~ "Downward (H to M)",
      isei_first == 4 & isei_last == 2 ~ "Downward (H to L)",
      isei_first == 3 & isei_last == 2 ~ "Downward (M to L)",
      isei_first %in% c(4,3,2) & isei_last == 1 ~ "Downward (Any to NEET)",
      TRUE                             ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(mobility_cat = factor(
    mobility_cat,
  )) %>%
 arrange(-n_obs)
}
frq(isei_mobility$mobility_cat)
table(isei_mobility$mobility_cat,isei_mobility$n_obs)
mobility_categories<- c("Downward (Any to NEET)","Downward (H to L)","Downward (H to M)","Downward (M to L)",
  "Upward (L - H)","Upward (L - M)","Upward (M - H)","Upward (NEET to Any)")
# Individuals with more than 75% of the time in NEET, have at least 3 observations and are wrongly classified as Downward or Upward mobility.
# isei_mobility$toNEET <- ifelse(isei_mobility$prop_mob1 >=0.75 & isei_mobility$n_obs>=3 & isei_mobility$mobility_cat %in% mobility_categories,1,0)
# Individuals with more than 75% of the time in Low, have at least 3 observations and are wrongly classified as Downward or Upward mobility.
isei_mobility$toStLow <- ifelse(isei_mobility$prop_mob2 >=0.75 & isei_mobility$n_obs>=3 & isei_mobility$mobility_cat %in% mobility_categories,1,0)
# Individuals with more than 75% of the time in Middle, have at least 3 observations and are wrongly classified as Downward or Upward mobility.
isei_mobility$toStMid <- ifelse(isei_mobility$prop_mob3 >=0.75 & isei_mobility$n_obs>=3 & isei_mobility$mobility_cat %in% mobility_categories,1,0)
# Individuals with more than 75% of the time in High, have at least 3 observations and are wrongly classified as Downward or Upward mobility.
isei_mobility$toStHig <- ifelse(isei_mobility$prop_mob4 >=0.75 & isei_mobility$n_obs>=3 & isei_mobility$mobility_cat %in% mobility_categories,1,0)
isei_mobility$mobility_cat_adj <- isei_mobility$mobility_cat
# isei_mobility$mobility_cat_adj[isei_mobility$toNEET==1] <- "Stable: NEET"
isei_mobility$mobility_cat_adj[isei_mobility$toStLow==1] <-"Stable: low"
isei_mobility$mobility_cat_adj[isei_mobility$toStMid==1] <-"Stable: middle"
isei_mobility$mobility_cat_adj[isei_mobility$toStHig==1] <-"Stable: high"

isei_mobility_sesclass <- isei_mobility
isei_mobility_sesclass <- isei_mobility_sesclass %>% rename(mobility_cat_adj_sesclass=mobility_cat_adj)
frq(isei_mobility_sesclass$mobility_cat_adj_sesclass)
```

```{r mediation-analysis}
pacman::p_load(dplyr,lme4,mediation,psych,texreg)
load(file = "input/data/proc/df1_panel_v2.RData");paneldata137 <- paneldata

paneldata137 <- paneldata137 %>% group_by(id) %>% mutate(n_obs=n())

paneldata137$mobility_profile <-car::recode(
  paneldata137$mobility_cat_adj,
  "c('Downward (Any to NEET)',
    'Downward (H to L)',
    'Downward (H to M)',
    'Downward (M to L)') = 'Downward';
  c('Upward (L to H)',
    'Upward (L to M)',
    'Upward (M to H)',
    'Upward (NEET to Any)') = 'Upward'
  "
)

# standardize predictors--------------------------------------------------------
paneldata137$isei_avg <- as.numeric(paneldata137$isei_avg/10)
paneldata137$n_total <- as.numeric(paneldata137$n_total/25)
paneldata137$isei <- factor(paneldata137$isei,levels = c(1,2,3,99))
paneldata137$isei <- relevel(paneldata137$isei,ref = 2)
paneldata137$age <- paneldata137$age 
paneldata137$neet <- ifelse(paneldata137$isei==99,1,0)
# If lab status is NEET, then ISEI =10
paneldata137$isei_c <- ifelse(paneldata137$isei_c ==0,10,paneldata137$isei_c) 
paneldata137$isco03_neet <- factor(paneldata137$isco03_neet)

# Network diversity for longitudinal analysis
pca_fit_v10 <- 
  psych::principal(r = as.data.frame(paneldata137) %>% 
                     dplyr::select("entropy_contacts","know_total"),
                   nfactors = 1,rotate = "varimax",scores = T,missing = T, 
                   cor = "cor",weight = paneldata137$weights1)
paneldata137$diversityclass <- as.numeric(pca_fit_v10$scores)


paneldata137$diversityclass_gm<- MLMusingR::group_mean(paneldata137$diversityclass,grp = paneldata137$id)
paneldata137$diversityclass_gc<- MLMusingR::group_center(paneldata137$diversityclass,grp = paneldata137$id)

paneldata137$n_total_gm<- MLMusingR::group_mean(paneldata137$n_total,grp = paneldata137$id)
paneldata137$n_total_gc<- MLMusingR::group_center(paneldata137$n_total,grp = paneldata137$id)

paneldata137$isei_avg_gm<- MLMusingR::group_mean(paneldata137$isei_avg,grp = paneldata137$id)
paneldata137$isei_avg_gc<- MLMusingR::group_center(paneldata137$isei_avg,grp = paneldata137$id)

paneldata137$isei_c_gm <- MLMusingR::group_mean(paneldata137$isei_c,grp = paneldata137$id)
paneldata137$isei_c_gc <- MLMusingR::group_center(paneldata137$isei_c,grp = paneldata137$id)

# --- Mediator model (M ~ X + controls + random intercept) ---
fit.M.between<- lmer(
  isei_avg_gm ~ mobility_profile+ n_total_gc+ n_total_gm + diversityclass_gc + diversityclass_gm+ sex +
    factor(time)+
    (1 | id),
  data    = paneldata137,
  weights = weights1,
  REML    = FALSE
)

# --- Outcome model (Y ~ M + X + controls + random intercept) ---
fit.Y.between <- lmer(
  market ~ mobility_profile+isei_avg_gc +isei_avg_gm+  n_total_gc+ n_total_gm + diversityclass_gc + diversityclass_gm+sex+
    factor(time)+
    (1 | id),
  data    = paneldata137,
  weights = weights1,
  REML    = FALSE
)

screenreg(list(fit.M.between,fit.Y.between)) 

# --- Imai et al. mediation step ---

500<- sims

med.between_status_stable_high <- mediation::mediate(
  model.m  = fit.M.between,
  model.y  = fit.Y.between,
  treat    = "mobility_profile",     # X
  control.value = "Stable: low", # 0 category of X 
  treat.value = "Stable: high", #  1 category of X
  mediator = "isei_avg_gm",   # M
  sims     = sims,            # increase for publication results (e.g., 2000–5000)
  boot     = FALSE            # keep FALSE when using robustSE+cluster (faster & coherent)
)

summary(med.between_status_stable_high)
save(med.between_status_stable_high,file = "mediation_WE_status_stable_high.RData")

med.between_status_stable_middle <- mediation::mediate(
  model.m  = fit.M.within,
  model.y  = fit.Y.within,
  treat    = "mobility_profile",     # X
  control.value = "Stable: low", # 0 category of X 
  treat.value = "Stable: middle", #  1 category of X
  mediator = "isei_avg_gm",   # M
  sims     = sims,            # increase for publication results (e.g., 2000–5000)
  boot     = FALSE            # keep FALSE when using robustSE+cluster (faster & coherent)
)

summary(med.between_status_stable_middle)
save(med.between_status_stable_high,file = "mediation_WE_status_stable_middle.RData")

med.between_status_stable_neet <- mediation::mediate(
  model.m  = fit.M.within,
  model.y  = fit.Y.within,
  treat    = "mobility_profile",     # X
  control.value = "Stable: low", # 0 category of X 
  treat.value = "Stable: NEET", #  1 category of X
  mediator = "isei_avg_gm",   # M
  sims     = sims,            # increase for publication results (e.g., 2000–5000)
  boot     = FALSE            # keep FALSE when using robustSE+cluster (faster & coherent)
)

summary(med.between_status_stable_neet)
save(med.between_status_stable_neet,file = "mediation_WE_status_stable_neet.RData")

med.between_status_stable_downward <- mediation::mediate(
  model.m  = fit.M.within,
  model.y  = fit.Y.within,
  treat    = "mobility_profile",     # X
  control.value = "Stable: low", # 0 category of X 
  treat.value = "Downward", #  1 category of X
  mediator = "isei_avg_gm",   # M
  sims     = sims,            # increase for publication results (e.g., 2000–5000)

)

summary(med.between_status_stable_downward)
save(med.between_status_stable_downward,file = "mediation_WE_status_stable_downward.RData")

med.between_status_stable_upward <- mediation::mediate(
```

```{r wright-scheme}
library(dplyr)

dfreg <- dfreg %>%
  mutate(
    # Extract first two digits from 4‑digit ISCO code
    isco_minor = as.numeric(substr(isco08_2lvl, 1, 2)),
    
    # Expert: minor group 10–26 AND tertiary education
    expert = ifelse(
      !is.na(isco_minor) & isco_minor >= 10 & isco_minor <= 26 & tertiary == 1,
      1, 0
    ),
    
    # Pérez‑Ahumada six‑class scheme
    wright = case_when(
      ownership == "employee"      & expert == 1 & is_supervisor_r == 1 ~ "Expert managers",
      ownership == "employee"      & expert == 1 & is_supervisor_r == 0 ~ "Experts",
      ownership == "employee"      & expert == 0 & is_supervisor_r == 1 ~ "Supervisors",
      ownership == "employee"      & expert == 0 & is_supervisor_r == 0 ~ "Workers",
      ownership %in% c("employer", "selfemployed") & expert == 1       ~ "Petite bourgeoisie",
      ownership %in% c("employer", "selfemployed") & expert == 0       ~ "Informal self‑employed",
      ownership == "notinlabor"                                       ~ "Not in labor",
      TRUE                                                               ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-isco_minor)  # remove temporary variable

dfreg$wright<- factor(dfreg$wright,levels = c("Expert managers","Petite bourgeoisie","Informal self‑employed","Experts","Supervisors","Workers","Not in labor"))

frq(dfreg$wright,out = "viewer")
frq(dfreg$isco03_neet)

dfreg %>% select(isco08_2lvl,m07,ownership,m06,is_supervisor_r,tertiary,wright,m02,isco03_neet) %>% View()

dfreg %>% select(isco08_2lvl,m07,ownership,m06,m05,is_supervisor_r,tertiary,wright,m02,isco03_neet) %>% 
  filter(is.na(wright))%>% View()


tab_xtab(dfreg$wright,dfreg$ola,show.na = T)

tab_xtab(dfreg$isco03_neet,dfreg$tertiary,show.na = T)
```

```{r}
      label = TRUE,
      to_factor = FALSE)    
  )

# for all these cases I should declare them: employees 0, self-employed=0.
classschemes <- 
classschemes %>% 
  mutate(
    self_employed_r_fix=ifelse((is.na(egp_11_lab_fix) & !is.na(isco03_neet)),yes = 0,no =self_employed_r_fix),
    n_employees_r_fix=ifelse((is.na(egp_11_lab_fix) & !is.na(isco03_neet)),yes = 0,no =n_employees_r_fix)
  )

classschemes <- 
classschemes %>%
  mutate(
    isco08_1lvl,isco03_neet,isco88res_3,
    is_supervisor_r,is_supervisor_r_fix,
    self_employed_r,self_employed_r_fix,
    n_employees_r,n_employees_r_fix,
    firm_size,isco88res_3,
    egp_11_lab_fix2=isco88_to_egp(
      isco88res_3,
      self_employed_r_fix,
      n_employees_r_fix,
      n_classes = 11,
      label = TRUE,
      to_factor = FALSE),
    oesch8 = isco88_to_oesch(
      isco88res_3,
      self_employed_r_fix,
      n_employees_r_fix,
      n_classes = 8,
      label = TRUE,
      to_factor = FALSE
)
    
  )

# EGP 11........................................................................
classschemes$egp_11_lab_fix2[classschemes$isco88res_3==110] <- "'IIIa: Routine Nonmanual'"
classschemes$egp_11_lab_fix2[classschemes$isco03_neet==4] <- "'NEET'"
classschemes$egp_11_lab_fix2 <-
  factor(stringr::str_replace_all(stringr::str_remove_all(classschemes$egp_11_lab_fix2, "'|:"), "-", " "),
         levels = c("I Higher Controllers","II Lower Controllers",
                    "IVa Self employed with employees",
                    "IVb Self employed with no employees",
                    "IVc Self employed Farmer",
                    "IIIa Routine Nonmanual",
                    "IIIb Lower Sales Service",
                    "V Manual Supervisors",
                    "VI Skilled Worker",
                    "VIIa Unskilled Worker",
                    "VIIb Farm Labor","NEET")
         )

dfreg$soclass <- classschemes$egp_11_lab_fix2

# Oesch 8 ..................................................................
classschemes$oesch8[classschemes$isco88res_3==110] <- "'Service workers'"
classschemes$oesch8[classschemes$isco03_neet==4] <- "'NEET'"

classschemes$oesch8 <-
  factor(stringr::str_replace_all(stringr::str_remove_all(classschemes$oesch8, "'|:"), "-", " "),
         levels = c(
           "Self employed professionals and large employers",  # Highest
           "(Associate) managers",
           "Socio cultural (semi )professionals",
           "Technical (semi )professionals",
           "Small business owners",
           "Clerks",
           "Production workers",
           "Service workers",'NEET'                             # Lowest
         )
         )

dfreg$oesch8 <- classschemes$oesch8

table(dfreg$oesch8,dfreg$soclass,useNA = "ifany")
frq(dfreg$oesch8)

dfreg %>% 
  group_by(oesch8) %>% 
  summarise(mean=mean(isei08res,na.rm=T),median=median(isei08res,na.rm=T),min=min(isei08res,na.rm=T),max=max(isei08res,na.rm=T))

dfreg %>% 
  group_by(soclass) %>% 
  summarise(mean=mean(isei08res,na.rm=T),median=median(isei08res,na.rm=T),min=min(isei08res,na.rm=T),max=max(isei08res,na.rm=T))

dfreg$informal <- car::recode(dfreg$m10,"c(1,2)=0;3=1")

table(dfreg$soclass,dfreg$informal)
table(dfreg$soclass,dfreg$firm_size)

dfreg$informal_prod<- ifelse(dfreg$firm_size>10,1,0)

table(dfreg$isco08_1lvl,dfreg$informal_prod)

dfreg <- dfreg %>%
  mutate(
    soclass3a = case_when(
      # HIGH (3)
      soclass %in% c("I Higher Controllers") ~ 3,
      # MIDDLE (2)
      soclass %in% c("IVa Self employed with employees","II Lower Controllers",
                     "IVb Self employed with no employees",
                     "IIIa Routine Nonmanual"                     
                     ) ~ 2,
      # LOW (1)
      soclass %in% c("IVc Self employed Farmer",
                     "IIIb Lower Sales Service",
                     "VI Skilled Worker","V Manual Supervisors",
                     "VIIa Unskilled Worker",
                     "VIIb Farm Labor") ~ 1,
      # NEET (4)
      soclass == "NEET" ~ 4,
      # Default
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

dfreg <- dfreg %>%
  mutate(
    soclass3b = case_when(
      # GROUP 3 (HIGH)
      soclass == "I Higher Controllers" ~ 3,
      
      # GROUP 2 (UPPER-MIDDLE)
      soclass %in% c("II Lower Controllers",
                     "IVa Self employed with employees",
                     "IVb Self employed with no employees",
                     "IIIa Routine Nonmanual",
                     "V Manual Supervisors") ~ 2,
      
      # GROUP 1 (LOWER-MIDDLE/WORKING CLASS)
      soclass %in% c("IVc Self employed Farmer",
                     "IIIb Lower Sales Service",
                     "VI Skilled Worker",
                     "VIIa Unskilled Worker",   
                     "VIIb Farm Labor") ~ 1,
      
      # GROUP 4 (NEET)
      soclass == "NEET" ~ 4,
      
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

polycor::polychor(dfreg$isco03_neet,dfreg$soclass3a)
polycor::polychor(dfreg$isco03_neet,dfreg$soclass3b)

table(dfreg$oesch8,dfreg$isco03_neet)

frq(dfreg$oesch8)

dfreg <- dfreg %>%
  mutate(
    oesch3a = case_when(
      # UPPER CLASS
      oesch8 %in% c("Self employed professionals and large employers",
                         "(Associate) managers",
                         "Socio cultural (semi )professionals",
                         "Technical (semi )professionals") ~ 3,
      
      # INTERMEDIATE CLASS
      oesch8 %in% c("Small business owners",
                         "Clerks") ~ 2,
      
      # LOWER CLASS
      oesch8 %in% c("Production workers",
                         "Service workers") ~ 1,
      
      # NEET
      oesch8 == "NEET" ~ 4,
      
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ) %>%
    sjlabelled::set_labels(labels = c("NEET" = 4,
                          "Lower Class" = 1,
                          "Intermediate Class" = 2,
                          "Upper Class" = 3)) %>%
    sjlabelled::set_label("Oesch 3-class vertical hierarchy")
  )

frq(dfreg$oesch3a)

table(dfreg$oesch8,dfreg$oesch3a,useNA = "ifany")
```
